title: Nguyen Van A - Senior Java Developer

basics.name: Nguyen Van A
basics.label: Senior Java Developer
basics.summary: 8+ years of experience in Java/Spring Boot ecosystem. Specialized in building scalable microservices, RESTful APIs, and cloud-native applications. Led a team of 6 developers to deliver enterprise solutions for banking and e-commerce domains. Passionate about clean code, system design, and mentoring junior developers.

work.summary: Lead a team of 6 developers building payment gateway serving 2M+ daily transactions.
highlights: Designed and implemented microservices architecture handling 50,000 requests/second
Reduced API response time by 40% through Redis caching and query optimization
Migrated monolithic application to Spring Boot microservices with zero downtime
Implemented CI/CD pipeline using Jenkins, Docker, and Kubernetes
Mentored 4 junior developers, 2 promoted to mid-level within 1 year

work.summary: Developed enterprise banking solutions for international clients (Japan, Korea).
highlights: Built core banking REST APIs serving 500+ bank branches nationwide
Integrated third-party payment systems (VNPAY, Momo, ZaloPay)
Implemented OAuth2 + JWT authentication for multi-tenant SaaS platform
Wrote 300+ unit/integration tests achieving 85% code coverage
Received 'Best Developer of the Year' award in 2020

work.summary: Developed web applications for US-based healthcare clients.
highlights: Built RESTful APIs using Spring Boot and Hibernate
Developed front-end components with Angular and TypeScript
Participated in Agile/Scrum with 2-week sprint cycles
Maintained and optimized PostgreSQL database with 10M+ records

education.institution: Ho Chi Minh City University of Science (HCMUS)
